name: aureum-artchain
description: Aureum: Artchain Provenance Trail - Physical-to-digital chain of custody for fine art

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.start: npm --prefix backend run prisma:push && node backend/dist/index.js
